# Ayantik Sarkar

> Ayantik Sarkar is a full stack developer and CTO at HoardSpace, currently
> studying Civil Engineering at the National Institute of Technology,
> Rourkela (NIT Rourkela). He builds scalable web applications and UI
> systems using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Node.js, and is the creator
> of Pulse UI, Elimics, and FormAS.

Ayantik Sarkar (also referred to as "Ayantik") is the sole author and
owner of this website. Contact: ayantik.sarkar2020@gmail.com.

## Experience

- Chief Technology Officer, HoardSpace Bookings Pvt. Ltd. (Dec 2025 – Present): Sole engineering lead for a full-stack B2B OOH/DOOH advertising booking marketplace (https://hoardspace.in), owning architecture, APIs, booking engine, admin dashboard, and CI/CD.

## Projects

- **HoardSpace** (https://hoardspace.in/): B2B marketplace for out-of-home (OOH/DOOH) advertising with maps and dynamic dashboards.
- **Pulse UI** (https://pulseui-henna.vercel.app): A reusable, production-ready animated React/Next.js component library, including the Pulse Toast npm package.
- **Elimics** (https://elimics.com): Smart link intelligence platform with real-time click and engagement analytics.
- **FormAS** (https://formas.space): Form Backend as a Service for static sites and frontend apps, with webhooks and spam protection.

## Skills

React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Java, C++, Tailwind CSS, Docker, Git, REST APIs, UI/UX Design.
